title: Chill Lo-Fi Beats on a Rainy Mountain Road
label: CHILL LO-FI
description:
Slow lo-fi beats on a rainy mountain road as the sun goes down. A red GT500 coming around a wet curve above the lake, the last orange light breaking under the storm clouds. Eight hours of soft keys, warm bass, quiet drums and a little vinyl crackle for sleeping, studying, or winding down after a long day in the bay.

No lyrics. No talking. Every track is original to this channel.

Built for mechanics, car people, and anyone who sleeps better with something chill playing.

Made by a mobile ADAS calibration tech. Absolute ADAS: https://absoluteadas.com
